# Recorded responses for the "Main St and Amherst St, Nashua NH" search

Real responses captured once on 2026-10-10 with the proxy's User-Agent
(`InsurifyAI-CrashScene/1.0 (+https://github.com/zohebzma2-cmyk/crash-scene-3d)`). Tests never call the services.

- `overpass-main-amherst-nashua.json`: Overpass API response (`out body geom`) for the query
  `overpassCrossingQuery("Main St", "Amherst St", <Nashua centre>, 1500)`. Road names, refs, lanes and geometry only; ways not named exactly "Main Street" or "Amherst Street" were removed (the answer is unchanged).
  © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0. https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
- `nominatim-nashua-nh.json`: Nominatim response for `q=Nashua NH` (the city). Data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.

No house numbers, people or personal data. Main Street and Amherst Street meet at OSM node 41353060.
